svg.title: Fig. 176 — The folium x³ + y³ − 3xy = 0 and its asymptote x + y + 1 = 0
svg.desc: Redrawn from Robert C. Yates, A Handbook on Curves and Their Properties (1947), Fig. 176, page 193. Section: sketching.

g.data-text: The axes: the folium has a node at the origin whose tangents are the two axes.
The asymptote x + y + 1 = 0 (found by m = −1, k = −1): draw the line through (−1, 0) and (0, −1).
Draw the loop in the first quadrant (it leaves the origin tangent to the x-axis and returns tangent to the y-axis), and the two infinite branches, which close in on the asymptote.
